backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining booking and user profile management with CRUD operations (createBooking, getAllBookings, deleteAllBookings, saveCallerUserProfile, getUserProfile), using role-based access control via MixinAuthorization and AccessControl modules.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with their associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels — covering the booking form pipeline, post-submission WhatsApp/email notification buttons, and related UI fixes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing short summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, hooks, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes (colors, radius, sidebar, charts) using the oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with full SEO metadata (title, Open Graph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema) branded as 'Omm Vedic Numerloggy' targeting numerology, vastu, tarot, and pronology keywords.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with two routes: '/' rendering HomePage and '/admin' rendering AdminPage.
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingsTa: Admin bookings display component rendering a responsive desktop table and mobile card layout with columns for Booking ID, name, phone, service, category, date, time, message, and status.
frontend/src/components/booking/BookingF: A multi-field booking form component that collects service type, category, date/time, and contact info, then submits via a custom hook and generates WhatsApp/email notification links for the admin.
frontend/src/components/home/AboutSectio: A static 'About Us' section displaying a two-column layout with descriptive text about Omm Vedic Numerology and a grid of four feature cards highlighting key practice attributes.
frontend/src/components/home/ContactUsSe: A static contact section that displays the business WhatsApp number and provides a direct wa.me link for users to reach out before booking.
frontend/src/components/home/FindUsSecti: A static location section showing the business's exact address in Bhubaneswar and a button linking to Google Maps for navigation.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: The full-screen hero banner with a background image, animated Om symbol, main heading, tagline, and two CTA buttons for booking and exploring services.
frontend/src/components/home/ServiceCard: A card component that displays a single service's icon, name, descriptions, price (₹400), and a 'Book Now' button that triggers the parent's booking callback.
frontend/src/components/home/ServicesSec: A section that renders a responsive grid of ServiceCard components for all available services, with a header and a pricing note footer.
frontend/src/components/home/WhyChooseUs: Renders a 'Why Choose Us' section with a 2-column grid of four benefit cards (numerology, vastu, tarot, pronology) and a flat-rate pricing note, styled with cosmic/gold theming.
frontend/src/components/layout/FloatingW: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation and SVG icon that links to a specific WhatsApp number.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Fixed navigation header with logo, desktop and mobile nav links for scrolling to page sections, and a subtle admin panel link icon.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines the ServiceData interface and exports an array of four services (Tarot, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology), each priced at ₹400 with descriptions and icon paths.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with an authenticated or anonymous identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for admin operations: checking if the caller is an admin, fetching all bookings, and deleting all bookings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a useCreateBooking mutation hook that submits a booking to the ICP backend actor and unwraps the Result variant, throwing a typed BookingSubmissionError on failure.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, and defines a cosmic dark theme with gold/amber custom CSS variables and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that handles Internet Identity login/logout, displays all bookings in a table, shows pending booking counts with a WhatsApp alert link, and provides a delete-all-bookings action.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main public-facing page that composes all home sections (Hero, Services, About, WhyChooseUs, FindUs, Contact, Booking) with smooth scroll navigation and a pre-selectable service for the booking form.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom fonts (Cinzel, Cormorant, Inter), oklch-based color tokens (gold, cosmic, amber), custom shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations (twinkle, float, accordion).
project_state.json: Tracks the state of the 'Omm Vedic Numerology' promotional website project at version 25, including architectural notes, known issues (booking form errors, missing time field, notification failures), and a list of existing and planned features like homepage, booking form, admin panel, and WhatsApp/email notifications.
